name: claude-mods
description: Function-hooks mods (bands, panes) for Claude Code

plugins.name: meter
plugins.description: Session meters above the prompt; /meter opens detailed metrics

plugins.name: agent-graph
plugins.description: Desktop-only pane drawing the session's running subagents as a left-to-right graph

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: At 40% of a large window (50% of a 200k one), a dedicated turn writes a handoff and the knowledge it names into an OKF bundle in .auto-handoff/, then the context is cleared and work continues

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Terminal status line under the prompt: model and effort, working directory and git state
